# 3. Data Import & Preparation

```{r}
#| label: data-import
#| echo: true
#| eval: false

# --- Import Raw Data ---
Data <- read.csv("Data_hashed.csv", header = TRUE)

# Snow metrics: seasonal averages, duration, density, and threshold counts
snow <- read.csv("season_summary_thresh.csv", header = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    Year_trend = Yr - 1979
  )

# --- Snow Metrics Collinearity ---
# Check correlation matrix among seasonal snow variables
snow_cor <- snow |> 
  dplyr::select(-season, -Yr, -Year_trend) |> 
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

round(snow_cor, 2)

corrplot::corrplot(
  snow_cor, 
  method = "circle", 
  type = "upper", 
  tl.col = "black", 
  tl.srt = 45, 
  addCoef.col = "black", 
  number.cex = 0.7
)

# --- Merging & Cleaning ---
Data <- Data |>
  left_join(snow, by = "Yr") |>
  mutate(
    wtd114 = as.numeric(wtd114),
    Yr = as.factor(Yr)
  )

# --- Splitting Groups (Unscaled) ---
# Filter complete cases for all covariates used across models
Data_lambs_uns <- Data |> 
  filter(Age == 0) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(wtd114),
    !is.na(pop_den),
    !is.na(avg_snow_depth),
    !is.na(days_count),
    !is.na(median_density),
    !is.na(Sex),
    !is.na(Survival)
  )

Data_females_uns <- Data |> 
  filter(Age >= 1, Sex == "Female") |>
  filter(
    !is.na(wtd114),
    !is.na(pop_den),
    !is.na(avg_snow_depth),
    !is.na(days_count),
    !is.na(median_density),
    !is.na(Age),
    !is.na(Survival)
  )

Data_males_uns <- Data |> 
  filter(Age >= 1, Sex == "Male") |>
  filter(
    !is.na(wtd114),
    !is.na(pop_den),
    !is.na(avg_snow_depth),
    !is.na(days_count),
    !is.na(median_density),
    !is.na(Age),
    !is.na(Survival)
  )

# --- Standardize Predictors (z-scores) ---

# 1. Lambs Scaled
Data_lamb_scaled <- Data_lambs_uns |>
  mutate(across(
    .cols = c(wtd114, pop_den, avg_snow_depth, days_count, median_density, 
              days_gt_10, days_gt_20, days_gt_30, days_gt_40, days_gt_50, 
              days_gt_60, days_gt_70, days_gt_80, days_gt_90, days_gt_100),
    .fns = ~ scale(.)[, 1]
  ))

# 2. Females Scaled
Data_female_scaled <- Data_females_uns |>
  mutate(across(
    .cols = c(Age, wtd114, pop_den, avg_snow_depth, days_count, median_density, 
              days_gt_10, days_gt_20, days_gt_30, days_gt_40, days_gt_50, 
              days_gt_60, days_gt_70, days_gt_80, days_gt_90, days_gt_100),
    .fns = ~ scale(.)[, 1]
  ))

# 3. Males Scaled
Data_male_scaled <- Data_males_uns |>
  mutate(across(
    .cols = c(Age, wtd114, pop_den, avg_snow_depth, days_count, median_density, 
              days_gt_10, days_gt_20, days_gt_30, days_gt_40, days_gt_50, 
              days_gt_60, days_gt_70, days_gt_80, days_gt_90, days_gt_100),
    .fns = ~ scale(.)[, 1]
  ))
```
